title: Finite game from a regular game
statement: Given a regular Unique Games instance, form a finite Unique Games instance with the same variables and with one constraint occurrence for each variable together with one of its neighbors. The source is that variable, the target is the neighbor, and the constraint permutation is the one assigned to that neighboring pair.
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of a regular Unique Games instance, including its hypotheses.
